facts.business: CSL Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) providing wholesale loans and SME retail loans across 7 states in India.
key_risks: Computation of impairment losses on loan assets involves significant management judgement and modelling assumptions
Asset quality and credit risk in SME portfolio with Stage 2 and Stage 3 assets
Concentration risk in wholesale loans (single stage portfolio)
Dependence on wholesale funding from banks and financial institutions
Interest rate risk on borrowings (7.98% to 12.75% per annum)
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not given any loans and advances in the nature of loans to firms/companies in which directors are interested. Related party transactions disclosed to stock exchanges and published on company website.
